bio: Also known as Lil Assassin. Very close to Tay600, JB Bin Laden, M-Thang and Spoon. Went to school in Atlanta where he became close friends with Lil Yachty. Was working on music with Lil Reese and Lil Herb before his death. Had a personal issue with Odey. His death was one of the reasons for the fall of the 600. Beat Lil Mick of 051 Young Money at his studio and was killed by Lil Mick a week later at the same place.

One of two founders of the 600. Gave his nickname to L'A Capone. Was summoned to testify against RondoNumba9 and Cdai but was killed before appearing. Known for sleeping with enemies' girlfriends including those from O'Block and the 600. His death was one of the reasons for the fall of the 600. Fought with Richie Jerk of Tyquan World.
Also known as BigSix0. Shot at TuTu's funeral. In 2015, traded a KTS member to get out of prison.
Him, CapFck12 and Jusblow shot at Steve Day in 2018 on the MOB. His sister is a snitch on RondoNumba9 and Cdai whose name appears in court papers. Originally from the 109th in the Wild 100's.
Was supposed to be released from prison in 2021. Declared war against 051 Young Money over a girl.

Was incarcerated for killing Javan. Close to Lil Steve. After L'A Capone's death and after a feature with Chaboki, racketed Chaboki, who had been L'A Capone's friend. Snitched on D.Rose and Cdai in 2019 for a chance at his appeal.

From Welch World, originally. Close to Tay Savage of Welch World. After Javan's murder, was questioned by police and mentioned RondoNumba9 and Cdai without formalizing. When summoned to formalize his statement, left Chicago for Atlanta and was searched for obstruction. Later arrested for failing to formalize but imprisoned for gun possession. His name never appeared officially and his information couldn't be used against Rondo9 and Cdai, but his police statement started the rumor and got him kicked out of the 600. Slept with Lil Durk's and Edai's ex-girlfriend. Formed a shooter duo with Cdai against STL.EBT.

From the base of Front$treet. Close to members like DaDa. Was the weapons supplier for Front$treet and the 600. Supplied the weapon used to kill Junebug of the MOB and revealed Junebug's position to DaDa so he could kill him. Very respected and indirectly linked to many murders and shootings.

Considered very savage back then. Robbed many houses, starting from the Wild 100's. Before his death, Scrapp often came to Front$treet to see FBG Brick. One day Scrapp pointed a gun at him, he approached until the gun touched his skull, and Brick had to separate them. Had a personal issue with Scrapp. Shot in front of Chicago police.
Snitched on Scrapp of the MOB at trial for Lil Steve's murder, though Scrapp still won his trial.
Also known as Koopa. From O'Block. One of the creators of TEAM600 (not to be confused with the 600). Introduced Chief Keef to the 600. Fought with C-Ball of STL.EBT.
Also known as Booda. Snitched on his brother for car theft.
Close to HK.

From Killaward 078 and remains close to them. Very close to T-Roy. Father Silk is a legend of Ada Park. Worked with Chief Keef in his rap career. Won his murder trial after killing Malcolm of FMG. Accuses B-Mike of O'Block and brother of Wooski of STL.EBT of snitching on him.
Close to Chief Keef and Prince Dre.
Also known as Askii. Cool with members of No Luv City. Cool with Lil Mister of Wuga World and Killa Kellz of Brick$quad 069.
Currently incarcerated and sentenced to 30 years for the murder of Malcolm of FMG. Admitted to shooting 15 or 16 times. Accused by King Von of snitching on him.
Close to Odee and T-Roy. Years ago robbed Chief Keef's house and stole items including a chain from Chief Keef and clothes from his daughter, all in front of members like BJ and B-Mike.

Also known as Sosa. Worked early with DJ Kenn of Front$treet and then Young Chop. Close to members like GBE Capo, Odee, Patoon and White White. Members of O'Block like BossTop and T-Roy complained that he doesn't do enough for their block but he remains on good terms globally. Beat Lil Mick when younger with M-Thang, Nino, Jusblow and Lil Ant. Fought with Tell of Jaro City, Millz of 051 Young Money, Tooka of STL.EBT and Dooski Tha Man of MOB.
OG of O'Block. Was originally a Gangster Disciple.
Also known as Hec. Close to Duke and Gleesh. Racketed Gucci of Jaro City.
Known for making a lot of money. Wife was close to P5 of Jaro City, the man he killed. Still maintains connections with Jaro City members.
Also known as Baby Boy. In good standing with Aero of 051 Young Money.
Originally from Goon Town. Killed a girl which led him to leave the Wild 100's for O'Block. Had family at E-Spot.
Racketed by TYMB. Clashed No Luv City on Twitter, prompting Zo to come shoot at him.
